data.one_liner: Widget for creating and managing text tags via a TextFormField
data.what_it_does: Allows users to input tags separated by a delimiter and displays them as chips. Supports customization of colors, separator, and chip position.
use_when: Need a simple tag input field in a form
Want to display tags as chips with minimal setup
avoid_when: You need advanced tag management (e.g., async loading, persistence, or complex validation)
You require a full-featured form builder or state management integration
strengths: Easy to integrate, null-safe, customizable colors and separator
Supports chip positioning and submit behavior
weaknesses: Limited to basic tag functionality, no persistence or async support
No built-in validation beyond empty/duplicate checks
No support for complex form integration
data.minimal_example:
ChipTags(
  list: _myListCustom,
  chipColor: Colors.black,
  iconColor: Colors.white,
  textColor: Colors.white,
  decoration: InputDecoration(hintText: "Your Custom Hint"),
  keyboardType: TextInputType.text,
)
